notes.title: Bunker Survival takes us to the dark and toxic future
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40160188/3a2a20fb171e25425fa7ecec81918b17041069cd.png[/img]

[i]The siren alarm wakes you up. It’s hard to say what time it is, as your bunker has no windows, but even if it did, the darkness outside is almost permanent. Your hand instinctively reaches for the gun. Staying here for much longer is not an option, as the supplies are running critically low. You stand up, put on your old, trusty overcoat and lean on the heavy door handle with all your weight to open it up. The red light of an alarm light hits you in the face. The toxic air is what you feel right after. You see two stray dogs feasting on what looks like to be human remains. You pull the gun up to your face and take your aim.
[/i]

notes.title: Our Survival Collection is growing!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/5144945cd373cb412fe39baaac8adae32247de5a.png[/img]

Learn more about our latests project, Serum!

After you woke up, the first thing you’ve noticed was the mysterious plug with a timer on your arm. 
You realise quickly that to survive you will have to find the healing Serum. 

In our game, you’re intoxicated with a deadly virus that is slowly killing your body. The only way to survive is by applying a special serum that will extend your life by only a couple of hours.
You don’t know who and why but you know one thing. Life is in your hands now and your only choice is to race against the time.
Do you have what it takes to reveal the secrets of the mysterious Serum? Find out the truth about its creators and purpose!

notes.title: Developing the Tech.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40160188/4b34cae3c90debf6b769b3a080ec1fe6414c0bf4.png[/img]

In the world of Bunker Survival, SmartWatch and junk technology are your best friends. 
That's why from the very beginning we were trying to create original post-apocalyptic tech.

We were brainstorming day and night for weeks to create something unique that will stand out from well-known to gamers gadgets from other games. Early concepts weren’t disappointing but it wasn’t what we were looking for. We knew we could make something more “our” and finally, we had it.

To all Survivors from around the world! 
Finally, we’ve found a safe space without radiation and anomalies. We repeat, we’ve found a safe space for all the Survivors and it’s our community Discord server!

Join other fans of the Survival genre and be always up to date with news from our studio!
You will find there all the news and information about our titles.
 Also, if you have any feedback, ideas to share or you just want to simply hang out with developers and bother us with questions, we’re there for you! Don’t hesitate and join our Discord today.
Be a part of the development and help us make better games!
